titre: Devoir de synthèse n°2 - Anglais (9ème année de base)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
The Internet has changed our lives in many ways. Today, students can find information for their homework in a few seconds, and people can talk to their friends and families all over the world for free. We can also learn new languages, watch educational videos and read books online. However, the Internet also has some disadvantages. Some young people spend too many hours in front of their screens and forget to do sport or meet their friends. Others visit dangerous websites or believe false information. Therefore, we must use the Internet wisely and never forget the real world around us.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (6 marks)
1) Give two advantages of the Internet mentioned in the text.   (1,5 marks)
2) Give two disadvantages mentioned in the text.   (1,5 marks)
3) What advice does the writer give at the end?   (1,5 marks)
4) Find in the text a word that means "in a careful and sensible way" = ______.   (1,5 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Put into the present perfect: The Internet (change) ______ our lives.   (1,5 marks)
2) Rewrite using "too much / too many": Some young people spend ______ hours in front of screens.   (1,5 marks)
3) Complete with a linker (however / because / therefore): We must use the Internet wisely; ______, we should not forget the real world.   (1,5 marks)
4) Give an adverb formed from the adjective "wise" = ______.   (1,5 marks)

III. WRITING (8 marks)
"Is the Internet good or bad for students?" Write a composition (about 12 lines) giving your opinion. Mention advantages and disadvantages and use linkers (however, because, therefore…).
